name: HandBrake-for-Nvidia
description: HandBrake is a tool for converting video from nearly any format to a selection of modern, widely supported codecs. The GUI of the application is accessed through a modern web browser (no installation or configuration needed on the client side) or via any VNC client. A fully automated mode is also available: drop files into a watch folder and let HandBrake process them without any user interaction. This is template for zocker160's container to simplify installation. You need to install ich777's nvidia driver before using this. For a complete documentation of this container, see https://github.com/jlesage/docker-handbrake#readme

paths.name: Watch Directory
paths.description: This is the watch folder of the automatic video converter. Any video copied into this folder will be automatically converted by HandBrake.

paths.name: Output Directory
paths.description: This is the default output folder for converted videos. Also used by the automatic video converter.

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: This is where the application stores its configuration, states, log and any files needing persistency.

paths.name: Trash Directory
paths.description: When trash usage is enabled, this is where the automatic video converter moves converted files instead of deleting them.

variables.name: Web Listening Port (Non-Bridge Network Type)
variables.description: Port used by the web server to serve the UI of the application. This port is used internally by the container and it is usually not required to be changed. NOTE: This setting is relevant only when the Network Type is set to something else than Bridge.

variables.name: HandBrake GUI State
variables.description: Setting this to 1 enables the HandBrake GUI, 0 disables it.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: State
variables.description: Setting this to 1 enables the automatic video converter, 0 disables it.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Video File Extensions
variables.description: Space-separated list of file extensions to be considered as video files. By default, this list is empty, meaning that the automatic video converter will let HandBrake automatically detects if a file, no matter its extension, is a video or not (note that extensions defined by the Non-Video File Extensions list are always considered as non-video files). Normally, this variable doesn't need to be set. Usage of this variable is useful when only specific video files need to converted.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Non-Video File Extensions
variables.value: jpg jpeg bmp png gif txt nfo
variables.description: Space-separated list of file extensions to be considered as not being videos. Most non-video files are properly rejected by HandBrake. However, some files, like images, are convertible by HandBrake even if they are not video files.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Overwrite Destination
variables.description: Setting this to 1 allows the final destination file to be overwritten if it already exists.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Source File Stable Time
variables.description: Time (in seconds) during which properties (e.g. size, time, etc) of a video file in the watch folder need to remain the same. This is to avoid processing a file that is being copied.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Minimum Title Duration
variables.description: Minimum title duration (in seconds). Shorter titles will be ignored. This applies only to video disc sources (ISO file, VIDEO_TS folder or BDMV folder).

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Main Title Detection
variables.description: Setting this to 1 enables HandBrake main feature title detection to try to guess and select the main title.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Check Interval
variables.description: Interval (in seconds) at which the automatic video converter checks for new files.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Number of Watch Folders
variables.description: Maximum number of watch folders handled by the automatic video converter.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Disable Progress in GUI
variables.description: Set to 1 to disable display of the video conversion progress in HandBrake GUI.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Custom HandBrake Arguments
variables.description: Custom arguments to pass to HandBrake when performing a conversion.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Install Packages
variables.description: Space-separated list of Alpine Linux packages to install. This is useful when the automatic video converter's hooks require tools not available in the container image. See https://pkgs.alpinelinux.org for the list of available Alpine Linux packages.

variables.name: Automatic Video Converter: Use Trash Directory
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable usage of the trash directory. So when the automatic video converter is configured to not keep sources, it will move files to the trash directory (/trash inside the container) instead of deleting them.
